4. Mr. A.K.M. Shahidul Huq, the learned Advocate for the petitioners submits that due to aforesaid reason which is bonafide, he could not appear before the court and he expressed his deep regret for the same and prays for restoration of the Rule by recalling and vacating the said order of discharge of the Rule for default. He further submits that if this case is not restored to its original file and number the petitioners will be highly prejudiced and will sustain irreparable loss and injury. 

 7. It further appears from the record that this Civil Revision No. 242/91 arose out of another passed by the learned District Judge, Narayanganj in rejecting the prayer of the petitioners for restoration in a Misc. Appeal which was dismissed for default on 23.5.86 arising out of two pre-emption cases vide Misc. Case Nos. 92 and 93/1968. The learned Advocate for the opposite parties strongly submitted that this matter has been dragging for more than 30 years and ultimately a widow is suffering who is not only sick but also unable to move.
